meeting.title: Roadshow refresh: C&I solar investment case

asks.text: Use the 2022 market size of $410m and the 2022-27 CAGR of 37% from Priya's sheet everywhere they appear on the market slide, chart data included.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: I'd want the market numbers in the deck to be the ones from Priya's sheet, not our old estimate.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: If one of them still says 380, an analyst will spot it straight away.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: Yes, do the chart data too, otherwise the bar heights won't match the labels.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Use the exact number from the sheet. 410.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: 410 then, wherever it shows up, and 37% for the growth.

asks.text: Make the CAGR on the contents page match slide 10.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Then that has to match. I don't want slide 2 saying 39 and slide 10 saying 37, that's worse than leaving both.

refs.speaker: Sofia Brandt
refs.quote: Yep, I'll change it to 37 there.

changes.rationale: The title's 2022 market size moves to the $410m in Priya's sheet.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Use the exact number from the sheet. 410.

changes.rationale: The title's CAGR moves to the 37% in Priya's sheet.

refs.speaker: Sofia Brandt
refs.quote: The sheet has the CAGR at 37.

changes.rationale: The header's starting market size moves to $410m while the $2bn end point stays.

refs.speaker: Sofia Brandt
refs.quote: And 2027 stays at $2bn, so the rest of the header doesn't change.

changes.rationale: The table's 2022 market-size cell moves to $410m so no figure on the slide still says 380.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: If one of them still says 380, an analyst will spot it straight away.

changes.rationale: The 2022 bar's chart data and workbook move to 410 so the bar matches its label.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: Yes, do the chart data too, otherwise the bar heights won't match the labels.

changes.rationale: The CAGR label over the chart moves to +37%.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: 410 then, wherever it shows up, and 37% for the growth.

changes.rationale: The contents page quotes the CAGR, so it moves to 37% to match slide 10.

refs.speaker: Sofia Brandt
refs.quote: Yep, I'll change it to 37 there.

flags.question: Which of Priya's two 2022 tariffs, the PPA tariff ($0.07) or the grid tariff ($0.11), should replace the $0.08 in slide 10's table?

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Oh, and use the new tariff while you're in there.

refs.speaker: Sofia Brandt
refs.quote: Priya's sheet has two tariffs though, there's a PPA one and a grid one, so I'm not sure which...

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Whatever Priya has, she'll know.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: We'll check with Priya.

held.text: Slide 9's $11bn full-potential figure stays until it is rerun on next quarter's IEA outlook.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: I'll be honest, the eleven billion feels aggressive to me.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Leave 9 for now and we'll redo it after the outlook.

held.text: The cover keeps March 2023, the date the work was done.

refs.speaker: Daniel Mercer
refs.quote: We usually leave the cover as the date the work was done.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Okay, leave it then.

held.text: The market size is not rounded to $400m; Grace withdrew that for the exact 410.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: Actually, no, I've changed my mind on that.

held.text: The London venue moving to the Fenwick is for Grace's events team, not the deck.

refs.speaker: Grace Adeyemi
refs.quote: No, that's all ours.
